ADENO_NOS.Irregular Malignant Glands: Variably sized, distorted glands infiltrate colorectal tissue, with crowded epithelial structures and disrupted normal mucosal organization.
ADENO_NOS.Cribriform Tumor Architecture: Confluent malignant glands form complex epithelial structures containing multiple closely spaced luminal openings.
ADENO_NOS.Desmoplastic Invasive Front: Angulated tumor glands and small epithelial groups infiltrate a reactive fibrous stromal compartment.
ADENO_NOS.Necrotic Glandular Lumina: Malignant glandular structures contain granular necrotic material, producing irregular intraluminal debris.
ADENO_NOS.Irregular Malignant Glands / Distorted L: Uneven glandular lumina are surrounded by atypical columnar epithelium with irregular epithelial contours.
ADENO_NOS.Irregular Malignant Glands / Nuclear Str: Elongated hyperchromatic nuclei overlap and stratify along the lining of malignant glands.
ADENO_NOS.Irregular Malignant Glands / Loss of Pol: Tumor cells show disordered nuclear orientation and variable positioning relative to the glandular lumen.
ADENO_NOS.Cribriform Tumor Architecture / Epitheli: Atypical epithelial bridges divide confluent glandular spaces into multiple smaller luminal compartments.
ADENO_NOS.Cribriform Tumor Architecture / Back-to-: Closely packed malignant glands have little intervening stroma and irregular shared epithelial boundaries.
ADENO_NOS.Cribriform Tumor Architecture / Crowded: Dense epithelial proliferations surrounding cribriform openings show overlapping hyperchromatic nuclei and variable nuclear size.
ADENO_NOS.Desmoplastic Invasive Front / Angulated: Irregular, sharply angulated malignant glands extend between collagen bundles at the tumor–stroma interface.
ADENO_NOS.Desmoplastic Invasive Front / Small Epit: Small clusters of atypical epithelial cells lie within reactive stroma near larger infiltrating glands.
ADENO_NOS.Desmoplastic Invasive Front / Reactive F: Collagen-rich tissue containing spindle-shaped fibroblasts surrounds invasive malignant glandular structures.
ADENO_NOS.Necrotic Glandular Lumina / Granular Cel: Glandular lumina contain granular eosinophilic material mixed with degenerating epithelial fragments.
ADENO_NOS.Necrotic Glandular Lumina / Karyorrhecti: Dark fragmented nuclear material is distributed within necrotic debris inside malignant glands.
ADENO_NOS.Necrotic Glandular Lumina / Viable Tumor: Atypical viable epithelial cells border luminal necrotic material, preserving recognizable malignant gland outlines.

MUCINOUS.Extracellular Mucin Lakes: Broad pools of extracellular mucin separate malignant epithelial elements and replace portions of the colorectal tissue architecture.
MUCINOUS.Floating Malignant Clusters: Detached epithelial islands and irregular tumor aggregates are suspended within extracellular mucin collections.
MUCINOUS.Mucin-Associated Gland Fragments: Incomplete glands and epithelial strips border or traverse mucinous regions, retaining variable glandular differentiation.
MUCINOUS.Fibrous Septa Between Mucin Pools: Collagenous tissue partitions separate adjacent extracellular mucin collections and support variable tumor-associated epithelium.
MUCINOUS.Extracellular Mucin Lakes / Pale Mucinou: Abundant pale extracellular material occupies spaces between malignant epithelial clusters within a mucin lake.
MUCINOUS.Extracellular Mucin Lakes / Sparse Tumor: Small viable tumor groups are separated by broad expanses of extracellular mucin.
MUCINOUS.Extracellular Mucin Lakes / Mucin-Lake B: The margins of extracellular mucin collections abut residual tissue, tumor epithelium, or fibrous stromal partitions.
MUCINOUS.Floating Malignant Clusters / Suspended: Compact aggregates of atypical epithelial cells have free surfaces surrounded by extracellular mucin.
MUCINOUS.Floating Malignant Clusters / Atypical C: Floating tumor aggregates contain enlarged, irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei with variable crowding.
MUCINOUS.Floating Malignant Clusters / Isolated M: Individual atypical epithelial cells or tiny detached groups occur between larger clusters in extracellular mucin.
MUCINOUS.Mucin-Associated Gland Fragments / Fragm: Discontinuous segments of atypical glandular epithelium line portions of extracellular mucin spaces.
MUCINOUS.Mucin-Associated Gland Fragments / Lumin: Small glandular openings are visible within epithelial aggregates embedded in mucinous material.
MUCINOUS.Mucin-Associated Gland Fragments / Mucin: Some malignant epithelial cells contain pale cytoplasmic mucin that alters the position and shape of their nuclei.
MUCINOUS.Fibrous Septa Between Mucin Pools / Coll: Eosinophilic collagen bundles form narrow tissue boundaries between neighboring mucin lakes.
MUCINOUS.Fibrous Septa Between Mucin Pools / Sept: Atypical epithelial strips or small tumor groups lie along fibrous septa bordering mucinous spaces.
MUCINOUS.Fibrous Septa Between Mucin Pools / Fibr: Spindle-shaped stromal cells and collagen are present in tissue partitions adjacent to mucin-associated malignant epithelium.
